operationName: Paraguay: Peña Impeachment & Ueno Bank Crisis
heroHeadline: Paraguay's Congress removes President Santiago Peña in impeachment after Ueno Bank collapse, BBC reports
heroSubtitle: BBC News Mundo reports Congress removed Peña in an impeachment trial following the Ueno Bank crisis; the opposition accuses him of conflict of interest over ties to the bank's owner. Reports of an arrest are unverified.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
